name: Pearl Drop Earrings
description: Dainty freshwater-style pearl drops on a lightweight gold-tone hook. Easy everyday earrings that go from class to dinner without a second thought.

name: Velvet Bow Hair Clip
description: A soft velvet bow on a strong-grip claw clip. Holds a half-up style all day without slipping out.

name: Rose Quartz Bracelet
description: Genuine rose quartz beads on stretch cord, finished with a tiny gold spacer. Stacks beautifully with your other bracelets.

name: Mini Quilted Sling Bag
description: A quilted mini bag with an adjustable chain strap — big enough for your phone, card case, and lip balm.

name: Butterfly Hair Pins (Set of 6)
description: Six mixed-size butterfly pins for pulling back face-framing pieces or dressing up a plain ponytail.

name: Layered Heart Necklace
description: Two dainty chains layered together, one finished with a small heart charm. Wear alone or stack with your favorites.

name: Enamel Stacking Rings (Set of 3)
description: Three thin enamel bands designed to be worn together or split across fingers. Adjustable to fit most sizes.

name: Satin Scrunchie Set
description: A set of soft satin scrunchies gentle enough to sleep in, sized to hold thick or thin hair without creasing.
